Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE, V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Specific Relief Act, 1963 – s.12, 13(1)(b) – Limitation Act, 1963 – s.18(1), Art.54 – Suit for specific performance involving third party – Grant of decree for specific performance – Correctness of – Held: High Court ought to have seen that the specific (predecessor of appellants) entering into an agreement with his brother’s wife for the purchase of a land for providing access to the land agreed to be sold under the suit Agreement of Sale; and (ii) the defendant then executing a sale deed conveying the property covered by the suit
